vintage: USDA ERS Feed Grains Database, Feed Grains Yearbook Tables -- All Years
tables: Table 22--U.S. corn and sorghum exports by selected destinations
Table 4--Corn: Supply and disappearance (validation only, not committed)
conversion: 1,000 metric tons x 0.03936822 = million bushels (1 bu corn = 56 lb = 25.4012 kg, so 1 t = 39.36822 bu)

tie_out.method: Table 22's World total compared against Table 4's US corn Exports for the same marketing year, in the same file and the same vintage

definitions.role: context only. This table tells a reader who buys US corn and how much; it enters no arithmetic in this model and is never used to convert a scenario into bushels
definitions.share_of_total_exports: a destination's exports over that marketing year's world total, both from Table 22
definitions.lag: Table 22 ends one marketing year before the balance sheet, which carries a WASDE projection. The two must never be presented as the same year

note: Built once by build_destinations.py and never edited by hand. The window is derived from the tie-out above rather than declared, so a future ERS backfill widens it on the next build instead of being locked out by a hard-coded start year.
